requirements.title: Front and rear seats comfortable for long drives across body sizes

requirements.recommend_rationale: Seats are the largest complaint theme of the interior (62 complaint rows, 2.4 % of all US complaints, level A) and both study attributes sit below the peer: front seat comfort 5.74 vs 6.04, rear seat comfort 5.27 vs 6.24. requirements.horizon_rationale: Cushion, contour and lumbar calibration change within the life-cycle impulse; no new architecture needed.

criteria.target: Can be set to a completely flat position

assumptions: Study scores of the next wave are comparable with the 2025 wave.

requirements.recommend_rationale: The operating concept is a level-A recurring complaint (53 rows, 39 of them usability) and is linked to the study attribute infotainment menu structure (4.88). G60-0051.text:
the interior hard plastics creak a lot and feel low quality. my car also has some fit and finish problems, like the driver side front window rattling.

sound system is weak compared to rivals.

range estimates are off, the efficiency stats shown are basically made up, and cold weather hits the range very hard.

the driver seat is extremely uncomfortable, especially in the lower back area, even with the lumbar turned down to minimum.

app remote link to the car is slow and often unreliable, even in the same places over and over - it says commands succeeded but they don't actually work. the app really needs the option to connect straight to the car via wifi or bluetooth when it's in the garage or similar.

classifications.level2_raw: Remote Engine Start (My BMW App / MINI App)

G60-0067.text: I had a very serious problem with Glove box - DTU: "hard to figure out where the glove box release is when its dark."

G60-0068.text: Customer reported the engine turns off at every stop and finds this irritating. Writer suggested using sport mode to disable that function. Customer agreed.

G60-0075.text: car is ok but not great. seat comfort should be better and massage should be offered as an option. esim is terrible with 2 or more cars, barely connects in either, so it feels useless. once configured, esim ought to be linked to the car for several users, not locked to one phone number.

G60-0081.text: the updated electronic features feel overly complex. with 2 user profiles the system seems to get mixed up, constantly flipping profiles, and even when i'm on mine the other person's music can start playing. the glass controls throw off a lot of glare, with the sun reflecting right into my eyes. there is also no option to turn off the auto start/stop.

G60-0117.text: I had a problem with Wireless charging pad - Broken/works inconsistently: "Wireless charging pad is placed ackwsrdly and the phone charges slowly on it"

G60-0135.text: Customer stated that he would like the vehicle to have a CD player.

G60-0143.text: Customer stated the Lane Departure Warning feature is extremely irritating and does not feel safe to him. Customer stated it frequently misreads the lane markings and at times actually tugs the car toward a lane that does not exist. Customer stated he is worried that in an emergency, if he could not use his turn signal, the system would resist him changing lanes and this could create a safety problem.

G60-0148.text: battery capacity feels insufficient and there are too many issues with charging. lately the cable keeps popping out instead of staying connected. overall it's more complicated to deal with than a tesla.

G60-0193.text: kind of unhappy that a brand new car already has had two big recalls while it still has under around 2k miles

G60-0197.text: I had a serious problem with Front heating/cooling controls/vents - DTU/poorly located: "The way they're made, recessed and with very limited adjustablity."

G60-0199.text: I had a very serious problem with Trunk/hatch/tailgate - Hard to open/close: "I FIND IT HARD TO GET THE TRUNK TO OPEN WHEN I SWING MY FOOT UNDER THERE AND I BE LOOKING CRAZY KEEP DOING IT SO I JUST USE THE TRUNK BUTTON ON THE FOB". Trunk/Hatch/Tailgate Problem Type: Hard to open

G60-0202.text: Customer stated wireless CarPlay will occasionally not connect. Customer stated he has had to reboot the phone, remove it from iDrive, then pair it again. Customer stated the issue has not appeared since the latest IOS update. Writer confirmed the phone as iPhone 12 MINI, carrier T-Mobile, IOS 17.6.1. Writer emailed additional troubleshooting steps should the problem come back.

G60-0203.text: Customer asked what valet mode is used for. Writer advised it can stop a valet from accessing his driver profile or the trunk.

G60-0212.text: Customer stated that his 550e has had what he believes to be a charging system failure on two separate occasions. Customer explained that the vehicle showed a 21% charge level, which suddenly fell to 3% when the engine was started, and then the car would not hold its charge. Customer noted the first occurrence was at around 450 miles. He stated the vehicle is now at his dealership for diagnosis and that the check engine light is illuminated. Key Read from when the vehicle went into service lists the mileage at 408 miles. Current software level G070-25-11-550.

G60-0217.text: Customer asked what the difference is between S Mode and Sport Mode. Writer explained that S Mode is the sequential setting, where you shift manually with the paddle shifters. Writer further advised that Sport Mode keeps the automatic transmission. Customer confirmed understanding.

G60-0221.text: I had a minor problem with Front heating/cooling controls/vents - DTU/poorly located: "tiny and hard to find"

G60-0222.text: the maple creek dealership basically lied about everything. i told them i didn't want the car until 5/21 and only after all the paperwork was signed they suddenly say they can't do that. i gave them a lease to match at 36/10000 and somehow they changed it to 7500. i wanted the camera to record while i am driving, but it only records about 30 seconds. they told me that once the system fully downloaded the feature would work, which was not true. i clearly said not to sell or share my information with sirius xm and they went ahead and did it. what i asked for and what was delivered did not line up. the contract is not the same as the lease i told them to match. their promises turned out to be lies. i won't get another bmw. the car app is poor. the trunk kick-to-open only works around half the time. you also can't remove apps even though they said you could.

G60-0236.text:
the interior feels like a step down from the previous model in both materials and equipment.

no full leather on the dash, no stitched leather on the center of the steering wheel, and there are a lot of hard plastics. the door cards look low quality, with the lower section being hard plastic.
there is no climate control for rear passengers and no led screen back there.
the sides where your knees rest should be soft leather like before.

front seats no longer have back pockets,
the door sill is missing and there is no soft close door.

overall the cabin comes across as cheap and not fitting for a car priced above about 90k.

G60-0241.text: this is my first bmw thats fully electric and so far the experience has been excellent and beyond what i thought it would be. i would have marked it a 10, but im already running into problems with the fast charger.

G60-0243.text: Customer stated that from time to time the lane keeping system seems to get confused and pauses before working, particularly when he is going through an intersection or where 2 lanes come together.

G60-0247.text: the paint seems to chip easily. the rear bumper section under the trunk gathers dirt and needs to be cleaned often. i still havent worked out how to use all the different gadgets.

G60-0252.text: Customer stated they would like the speed limit indication on their display to be more accurate, as it is wrong more often than not.

G60-0284.text: I had a minor problem with Trunk/hatch/tailgate - Hard to open/close: "Foot sensor activation is difficult". Trunk/Hatch/Tailgate Problem Type: Hard to open

G60-0301.text: really solid build quality, but it should have been a true from-scratch pure electric design. the climate control setup and the air vents are terrible. should have proper analog controls with usable vents. the car doesnt feel agile or nimble, and it ought to, even if the batteries are heavy. my car keeps dropping the connection so the app is out of sync, often forcing a 70 second hard reset or a call to a genius for a forced update. still, i am interested in watching how the i5 and later versions evolve.

G60-0344.text: Customer commented that the cupholders feel undersized and not appropriate for this vehicle.

Any time I pull a cup out or put one in, the retractable pieces make noise and it annoys my husband. He drives an HMC truck and its cupholders are quiet, no sounds at all. G60-0401.text:
no proper gear shifter, just that goofy little switch, and the controls are a pain to work with. half the settings don't stay put after i shut off the ignition. the retractable steering wheel doesn't slide back by itself when i turn the car off and open the door. ac won't hold the recirc setting, it changes once the car is turned off, same annoyance. also really dumb that the engine "off" at stops got deleted. the on/off button is crammed next to other buttons so you might kill the engine at the wrong time. simple buttons would do a better job for changing drive modes than that silly dial and the touch screen. the car feels too bulky and wide, which makes parking more of a chore. in sport mode the mpg drops from about 34 to around 28, yet the sport mode doesn't feel all that spirited. the sport seat hugging you is fantastic but it only happens in sport mode. cleaning the windshield is awkward because the wipers don't pull away far enough. the warning system for people approaching the car from any direction isn't sensitive enough, so i have to stare around a lot more. 

the good bits are the automatic backup feature, really useful given how big the car is, and the b & w stereo, miles better than the karmon-hardin setup, plus this one came with normal tires instead of run flats! that sport seat wrap that grabs you is excellent, just a shame it only "shows up" in sport mode.

G60-1562.text:
1. forward collision warning and automatic emergency braking
this car is supposed to come with standard forward collision warning and automatic emergency braking, but those features basically do not work. i have contacted your technical support several times, and although they made some tweaks, the system still does not function.

in june 2025 i brought the car in again for checks. the technical advisor, michael, rode with me and we tried different driving situations and maneuvers, yet the system never reacted at all, no warning lights, no alerts, no braking. i also tried it myself on i-25 at highway speeds, deliberately getting within about 5 feet of other vehicles, and it still failed to activate.

the sensor area has been kept clean and clear, we have gone through all the settings and looked at the owner's manual, but the problem continues.

i realize the collision avoidance is only meant to assist, not replace careful driving, but i got used to relying heavily on a similar setup in my previous lexus. i expected the bmw system to work at least as well and would like ongoing help to find a fix.

2. homelink garage door opener
the second issue is with homelink. two of your technical advisors came to my home to try and pair it with my garage opener, but they couldn't get it to sync. later i brought in a professional opener technician from liftpro, who finally managed to create a connection, yet the homelink is still unreliable and only works now and then.

most of the time when i come home, the car will not open the garage door. i end up parking, going in through the front door, and opening the garage by hand, which basically defeats having the integrated system in the first place.

this is my fourth bmw, and this 530ix really does not let me down. the tech makes it easier to drive and adds safety with things like lane warning, blind spot alerts and the little beepers. the ride itself is very smooth.
my last sedan was a 2013 535ix, so a lot of the differences stand out. for one, the doors on this car feel much lighter than before. i liked the heavier doors, and these new ones sound kind of hollow. the audio system also powers up as i walk up to the car, whether it is sirius or pandora from my phone. i am old school, i always turn the radio off before shutting the car, so this is annoying. plus, when other people get in, they might end up hearing something that is not appropriate for them.
then there is the auto start/stop, which in my opinion cuts in way too quickly. after just an instant of being stopped the engine shuts off, and with summer heat that drop in a/c feels uncomfortable. turning it off every single time i start the car is really inconvenient.
lastly, i have to admit i did not pay much attention to the trim level when i ordered this one, and i miss a few of the features that came with the nicer package on my previous car. since this one is leased i will probably just hand it back at the end and go for an upgraded model. i love my cars, the dealership, and the service department/manager, and i do not see myself switching to somewhere else.

G60-3168.text: Customer stated the BMW documentation for the enhanced driving assistance features is awful and basically useless, and commented that they learn far more from YouTube than from the manual or anything on the BMW website. Customer stated that improved documentation would be very helpful because the system appears to do many things that you only stumble across by accident. Customer stated he wants much better and clearer information about how the Assisted Driving features work going forward.

G60-3176.text: Customer asked how they would be informed if a software update becomes available for the vehicle. Writer advised that notifications will appear in the vehicle or through the My BMW app. Customer acknowledged this.

G60-3241.text: I had a very minor problem with Doors - Hard to open/close: "(Copied from PWR97): The car will not start unless the driver door is fully closed. Sometimes you think the doors are shut but they are not, including the rear ones. The doors don't always latch right and often have to be slammed."

G60-3244.text: Customer stated she is frustrated that simple functions such as heating have to be controlled through the screen instead of with traditional buttons.

G60-3248.text: too much of this stuff belongs on a laptop, not inside a car. my last car, designed around 15 years ago, had four overall use modes plus one fully custom, and you could toss anything you wanted in and out of that custom setting. now you basically have two, and the rest are just when they dress dressing. another issue is the limited storage and no salt sound in what little storage there is. on the positive side, fuel economy is excellent for such a strong engine, and visibility is restricted enough that you end up relying on the cameras to get into tight parking spaces. the ride itself is outstanding. i went for most of the upgrades like suspension, leather, adjustable seats and similar, and the five ran me roughly $80,000.

G60-3254.text: Customer commented that the only drawback is the range, and that with the current weather they are typically seeing an estimated range of around 200 miles.

G60-3263.text: overall it is an outstanding vehicle. the apple carplay integration, however, needs improvement. with several drivers, it ought to connect to the phone linked to the active bmw profile id, but instead it often grabs the last phone it used, which can be different from whoever is driving. it should also allow more than two driver profiles, since our adult kids sometimes use the key and should have their own profiles instead of relying on the guest setting.

G60-3264.text: I had a problem with Trunk/hatch/tailgate - Touch-free sensor doesn't work consistently/DTU: "just inconsistent and not reliable when you need it most."

G60-3299.text: Customer stated they hear a rattling noise from the passenger seat when no one is sitting there while he is driving, with mileage around 170. Writer asked if it could just be the seatbelt sitting in an odd position. Customer stated they have not specifically checked that but have noticed the sound disappears when there is weight on the seat. Writer advised taking the car to the dealership for a thorough check of the issue.

G60-3313.text: this would have been a 10 rating if we hadn't run into two issues in the first couple of months.

G60-3349.text: I had a very minor problem with Glove box - DTU: "the button you use to open it is hard to locate and awkward to push"

G60-3359.text: Customer mentioned it bothers her that the car unlocks in the garage every time she walks up to it. Writer explained the exclude from home option. Writer had the customer check that her home address is stored. Writer then advised, once it is saved, to go to Apps, Doors and Windows, Comfort Access, and select Exclude from home. Writer also clarified this only changes the unlocking behavior and not the locking, and the customer said she understood.

G60-3369.text: Customer stated that the location of the gas gauge on the dashboard can be very confusing, especially for her husband while he is driving.

G60-3377.text: ride and handling are excellent, same with the driver assist and safety features. the controls are quite complex though, so it is hard to really use 100% of what the car can do.

G60-3392.text: Customer stated the seat shape and lumbar support are problematic for shorter drivers around 5 feet tall, hitting in an uncomfortable area even with lumbar set to minimum. Customer stated there should be a setting to remove lumbar support entirely and mentioned having to use a very high seat pillow as a workaround.

G60-3395.text: Customer indicated that the language used in the Owner's Manual is confusing. Customer further stated that sometimes a single feature is referred to by two different names, one in the Owner's Manual and another within iDrive.

G60-3407.text: Customer reported that the tailgate occasionally opens by itself at random times, and writer advised the customer to have service inspect it.

G60-3415.text: I had a problem with Trunk/hatch/tailgate - Touch-free sensor doesn't work consistently/DTU: "the sensor only sporadically detects the foot movement."

G60-3416.text: Customer states the backs of the front seats no longer have the storage flaps.

G60-3429.text: Customer reported that after using the vehicle a few times, he began experiencing a problem where the charging socket cover would not close properly. Customer stated that roughly every second time he tries to shut the door, it refuses to close. Writer explained that the charging cover includes a lock that is connected to the vehicle's door lock system. Writer recommended locking and unlocking the doors to see if that helps the charging door close. Writer further advised that if the issue becomes too troublesome, the customer should bring the vehicle in for service.

G60-3434.text: overall i really like the car, it looks gorgeous both outside and in. i just wish it could go a bit longer between charges. i'd also prefer that when i get out, all four doors unlock instead of only the driver side. i turned off the auto lock when walking away, but for some reason it strated locking itself again.

G60-3438.text: Customer stated that while using Active Cruise Control it feels frightening when the car warns him to put his hands back on the steering wheel and, if he does not, the vehicle begins to slow. Customer stated he is not sure whether in that situation the vehicle is attempting to stop completely or to pull him toward the side of the road.

G60-3471.text: I had a minor problem with Wireless charging pad - Broken/works inconsistently: "the charging is terrible and basically won't charge my phone. the other side of the pad doesn't do anything at all, so why is it even there? i have to keep a cable charger handy if i actually need my phone to charge or if someone else does. they left that open spot making it seem like the passenger side would charge too, but it doesn't."

G60-3479.text:
the "driving machine" part really is "ultimate", but the infotainment setup badly needs some refinements. bmw seems to have no real way for owners to send in feedback or ideas to fix the counterintuitive parts of the system, and the geniuses at the dealer told me there isn't any channel for that.
one specific problem is the auto lock/unlock when you come up to the car or walk away. that function is great anywhere except at home. in my garage i'm walking past the car over and over while i work, and each time it goes on and off repeatedly. that cannot be good for the car, and the only way i could stop it was to switch the entire feature off.
this exact issue shows up as a common complaint online, and i found out that i-drive 8.5 has a setting to disable the comfort access "at home" only. that would be a perfect fix, but when i tried to change my settings so i could actually enjoy the feature i paid for, i discovered it only exists on 8.5 in the 7-series, not on the same 8.5 in my 5-series.
for me that is a real "deal-breaker". bmw is aware, or absolutely should be, that this is a problem. they clearly already have a solution, but 5-series owners are blocked from using it. i have a whole list of other issues and would gladly go over them with someone who truly cares. they're simple, common-sense fixes i'd provide for free... if there were any line of communication.

G60-3480.text: a remote door unlock feature would be really helpful. i ended up locked out of my car even though i had configured the key in the bmw app, but it wouldn't work. the black key card i'd set up did open the door, yet the car wouldn't start with it, so i had to take an uber back home just to grab my fob.

G60-3487.text: the car turned out a bit smaller than i thought. it is difficult to get in and out. the back doors won't open by touch and have to be operated from the front door panel. the trunk is very deep, and i feel some of that space could be used instead to give a bit more interior room.

G60-3497.text: Customer stated that the Electrify America stations were poor, and that many times they are either closed or not functioning.

G60-3500.text: Customer remarked that she does not like the design of the cupholders in the door panel. Customer stated her drinks do not stay fully upright and instead lean a bit, and she feels the design is goofy.

G60-3507.text: Customer stated there was difficulty setting up a second digital key for her husband's Google Pixel phone. Customer explained the car would not recognize his approach, forcing him to use the phone directly instead.

G60-3530.text: Customer stated the brakes are squealing a lot. Writer advised the customer to bring the vehicle to the dealer so the brakes can be inspected.

G60-3533.text: Customer stated they do not like the new vent system. Customer stated it is difficult to adjust the vents while driving.

G60-3536.text: Customer inquired about how to add his driver profile to the vehicle. Writer advised: BMW ID, add BMW ID, log in with the My BMW app, then scan the QR code. Customer acknowledged.

G60-3556.text: Customer indicated there is a knocking sound coming from the front passenger door of the vehicle and said he plans to bring it in to have it checked at some point in the future.

G60-3565.text: Customer reported that at home the car kept locking and unlocking repeatedly when not desired. Writer explained the fix is to enable Exclude home within the Comfort access settings.

G60-3573.text: Customer stated the key seems very active when the vehicle is at their house, and if they get close or move the key around inside, they can hear the car unlocking in the garage. Customer stated they need to change a setting so it stops doing that. Writter offered to adjust the setting together with the customer, but they declined the offer.

G60-3586.text: I had a minor problem with Touchscreen/display screen - DTU: "there are so many different features that it becomes hard to track down the exact one I am trying to use."

G60-3594.text: Customer stated the digital key is not functioning every single time. Customer stated he contacted genius, and they had him update the car and pair the digital key again, which has improved it, but the conection rate is still uneven and not fully reliable.

G60-3612.text: Customer asked about making a driving mode the default. Writer advised the steps: my modes, pick mode, settings, start mode.

G60-3630.text: Customer reported that the general storage space feels reduced compared with earlier 5 Series models. Customer also noted there is no longer a storage pouch on the rear side of the front seats.

G60-3636.text:
the car is really fantastic overall. it has the best ride of any vehicle i've owned, and i really like the acceleration. the level 2 driving *mostly* works very well, though i haven't really played with the self-parking yet.

my issue with the self driving is that it reacts too slowly when another car moves into or out of the lane ahead. once a slower car pulled into my lane and then had to brake because of traffic. the bmw 550e kept going at a higher speed as that car merged, and when they hit their brakes my car had to slam on the brakes hard. i honestly thought i was going to crash, but luckily it didn't happen.

the hybrid setup is great because it cuts my fuel costs a lot. the downside is that if the destination is a fair distance away, the car uses *all* the available battery to get there, so you can't then precondition the car for the drive back.

while i did have the money to buy it, i still feel it's a bit on the pricey side, and that makes me less willing to recommend a somewhat overpriced car to friends.

G60-3638.text: I had a minor problem with Front heating/cooling controls/vents - DTU/poorly located: "A/C vents are tricky to adjust and not easy to aim in certain directions."

G60-3648.text: Customer inquired about setting up the Digital Key. Writer walked the customer through the process, starting from the My BMW app and confirming both keys were in the vehicle. Customer acknowledged the guidance.

G60-3654.text: every drive makes me fall for this car all over again. i usually leave it on the charger in my garage and set a departure time so it's preconditioned to the perfect temperature. as i come within about 10 feet with my android phone using digital key plus, the car lights up and unlocks. i love that it powers up without any engine sound, with the seat gliding forward and the steering wheel dropping into place. getting in and out of my tight two-car garage, where my wife's audi sits beside it, is effortless thanks to the overhead view. out on the horrible texas roads, it's insanely quiet and so smooth that i now keep the superb b&w audio turned down much lower than in my old car. even so, it will out-accelerate anything out there with just a gentle press of the accelerator, and the steering reacts instantly with zero roll. it holds the lane and distance to the vehicle ahead, matching its speed calmly while my hands are off the wheel, and the way it does that feels almost uncanny. the eye-controlled lane changes are incredibly convenient, practically like magic. using plug & charge at ea is simple too: plug in, tap the "start charging" button on the display, and go grab a coffee. for me it's the ultimate stress-free and pampering driving experience, in a car that looks better than any of the recent bmws. i only have three small wishes: 1) the eye monitoring is overly picky, since i can't even sip coffee while keeping my eyes on the road above the mug without getting told off by driving assist plus (hands off); 2) the eye-based lane change only works if you're running gps navigation; and 3) in north america the adaptive headlights are just high/low beam instead of the selective dimming used elsewhere, even though selective dimming has been allowed in the us for two years now. i'm also really pleased another ea station opened right along the highway i drive most, roughly midway between home and austin. in my mind the 5-series has always been the best bmw, and this i5 m60 is the best of the 5s. it's pricier, but absolutely 100% worth it.

G60-3660.text: you don't get a complete battery charge when it's cold out.

G60-3676.text: Customer stated the driving experience was somewhat confusing at first to know exactly what everything does, but that they are starting to get the hang of it.

G60-3685.text: the car itself is very good. the open recall, however, is really disappointing. bmw sent a letter that essentially says the issue is dangerous but there is no repair available right now. i have never run into something like this before.

G60-3687.text: Customer reported that the Digital Key is inconsistent and at times will not unlock the vehicle upon returning, so they have to use the BMW app instead. Writer offered to assist with troubleshooting and advised that the Digital Key might need to be reset if the issue keeps happening. Customer declined additional troubleshooting for now, saying it is not a major concern at the moment, and agreed to contact us if the problem remains.

G60-3697.text: Customer stated charging from a standard household outlet is very slow versus his prior Volvo hybrid, and stated this vehicle requires the whole night to reach a full charge.

G60-3704.text:
overall the car is really great, and there's a lot to appreciate about it both when i'm driving and as someone who owns it. i'm obsessed with how it looks; i honestly get giddy every time i walk up to it. the build quality is the main reason i picked this instead of a model s, and as a car it's fantastic. launch mode, the light bar, all sorts of details are just awesome. but i still only give it about a 7 or 8 out of 10 because of the range, the seats, the way you can (or can't) customize things, and the cabin space.

range - i get the mindset that if it's electric then it's meant to be a commuter, but that really doesn't fit every demographic or psychographic. i work from home, so most of the time it's just driving me around town and to the airport, but the car is so addictive to drive that we're now actively planning road trips and at the same time complaining about its range. there are areas of our state, utah, that we simply can't go to because the charging infrastructure just isn't there yet.

on top of that, i'm really annoyed that you rolled out a mid-cycle efficiency update on the i5 only about four months after i bought mine.

seat comfort - i have a hard time getting comfortable in these seats. people like me with office jobs usually don't have perfect backs, so we need a way to make the seat flatter and less curved in certain spots to be comfortable. the lumbar is too aggressive by default and you can't get the seat bottom to go truly flat either. having more adjustment options would be very welcome. let the seat move to a completely neutral position first, then let us tailor things from that baseline.

cabin space - this is the most money i've ever paid for a car, and even though the i5 is about the same size as a 7-series was ten years ago, my rear passengers have less room than they did in my 2009 nissan altima. way too much space has been allocated to the trunk. even giving the back seat one extra inch of legroom would improve it. i'm 6 feet tall, and with the comfort exits turned on, when i get out or in i basically crunch whoever is sitting behind me. that's not acceptable for a car in this price range.

in-car & app customization - personal mode should really be a blend of the best parts of all the different driving modes. i want personal mode to truly mean personal. for example, i love the sounds from expression mode, but i don't want the rest of expression mode active; so why can't i pull just those sounds into personal, or bring any single setting from the other modes into personal mode? on the app side, my 2022 hyundai tucson actually offers more customization, especially around the climate controls. i get that you're aiming for a simple "one button, no thinking" climate concept, but i want the ability to build my own climate profiles: like a winter@80deg setting with seat heaters, or a summer@65 setting with the seat coolers on. the last-used climate setup isn't always what i want the car to return to when i get back in. tesla is really doing great things in their app right now; pretty much any function on the car has an api call and can be accessed directly through the app. that's the kind of direction i think you should move toward.

and one more note about expression mode: it has the best sound design overall, but the sound it makes at 'idle' is this high-pitched whirr, and that noise alone keeps me from using it regularly. if that whirr weren't there, expression mode might actually become my default setting.

G60-3731.text: Customer stated he wanted to know how to view the mileage in the instrument cluster. Writer explained how to bring up the mileage and advised using the steering wheel buttons to scroll through the available displays until that one appears.

G60-3735.text: Customer stated she is still figuring out how to use the parking assistant and is not confident about all of its functions yet. Writer suggested she practice using it on quieter streets, and the customer agreed that this sounded like a good idea.

G60-3738.text: Customer stated the Bluetooth connection keeps dropping off and on. Customer stated he has to re-establish the connection each time to get his phone to hook up again via Bluetooth. Writer asked whether the customer was currently near the vehicle. Customer stated he was not with the vehicle at that moment. Writer was not able to launch RVG. Writer advised the customer to have the phone forget the car and have the car forget the phone, then set up pairing again as if it were a brand new device. Writer further advised the customer to perform a 70 second reboot of the iDrive by holding down the volume knob. Customer stated he would try both of those steps to see if they improve the Bluetooth issue. Writer asked what type of phone he is connecting. Customer stated it is an Android S23. Writer asked which carrier he uses. Customer stated Verizon. Writer asked if any other devices are paired over Bluetooth in the car. Customer stated there is also an iPhone paired, but it is rarely used.

G60-3753.text: Customer stated the shiny interior trim shows fingerprints all over the place, and stated he would rather have a different type of interior finish.

G60-3791.text: I had a serious problem with Rear heating/cooling controls/vents - DTU/poorly located: "not really clear how the warm air gets to the back area"

G60-3797.text: Customer mentioned he assumed the vehicle could set up scheduled charging but was not clear on the process. Writer informed Customer this can be configured in the MyBMW app or directly in the car's charging app.

G60-3842.text: Customer asked if the My BMW App would alert him when a new remote software update is available. Writer advised that he would receive a notification there and also see it in the vehicle. Writer explained that if it appears in the app, he should download it to his phone first and then transfer it to the vehicle to install. Customer acknowledged.

G60-3863.text: the tech in this car feels like too much to learn. i honestly don't think i'll fully figure out everything it can do even after years.

G60-3875.text: I had a serious problem with Touchscreen/display screen - DTU: "It is difficult to figure out where I should go to get the answers I need."

G60-3887.text: overall i really like the car and the way it drives and takes corners, but the front seats are extremely uncomfortable for anyone around 5'8" or shorter. the lumbar section can't be flattened, so neither my husband nor i can get proper back support. because of that we only use it around town and can't take it on trips, which is very disappointing for us.

G60-3888.text: electronics integration has finally caught up with the car's excellent handling. it took several generations of the vehicle to achieve this balance.

G60-3889.text: Customer stated the vent air flow controls are overly sensitive and lack resistance. Customer stated he frequently shuts the vents by accident without realizing it.

G60-3894.text: i got my first 5 series back in about 2001 and this is basically the only kind of vehicle i've driven. now i'm on my 5th 5 series and it's the best handling car i've had, which is why i rated it a 10. however, the tech is distracting and most of it i won't end up using. safety matters most to me and going into the screen takes my eyes off the road. my earlier cars were more basic, and that's what i actually like. i'm really upset that the cd player is gone. i spent just under $950 on the upgraded speakers and then found out the cg player was taken out, and the sales person never told me. i know there are other ways to play music, but i want to choose for myself. in short the car is fantastic, but it's also kind of a nuisance. less is more.

G60-3898.text: Customer mentioned that reaching all of his HVAC settings requires going too far into the menu structure. Customer stated there are too many separate menus involved to access the various HVAC options.

G60-3902.text: I had a serious problem with Over-the-air vehicle software update problem: "i had to bring the car to the dealer for an update, since i never got any OTA update notification.". Which problem with RSU?: Other

G60-3909.text: Customer inquired about RSU and how they would be notified of them. Writer advised that both the vehicle itself and the myBMW app will alert them when an RSU becomes available. Writer advised that the driver can choose to install the update through their mobile device and then sync it to the vehicle later, or they can perform the installation directly in the vehicle, which takes roughly 20 minutes.

G60-3946.text: Customer asked which setting to use among Adaptive, High, Medium, or Low. Writer used RVG to confirm what the customer was looking at. Writer explained that these options control the brake regeneration. Writer advised that Adaptive varies the amount of regeneration with driving conditions, while the other levels keep the regeneration at a fixed level.

G60-3962.text: Customer reported that the charging rate is not reaching the advertised 205KW, and that he is only seeing about 150 KW when he charges.

G60-3993.text:
this is my 5th bmw vehicle.
all of my earlier bmws were bought new and then swapped out for another one in under 4 years, in this order:
550i
540i
740i
550i
now a 530i
i realize i am now in the regular 5 series, which i chose because, in my view, quality and functionality have gone backwards overall. that is not just about this 530 compared to those older cars.
my issues are:
run flat tires mostly gone and no spare?
1) putting a 4 cylinder motor in any 5 series
2) air conditioning feels downgraded and not strong enough for south texas heat
3) ac/vent fan is too noisy except on the lowest level. with the fan high, you basically cant talk on the phone.
4) auto stop/start, but the driver does not have simple, effective full control to switch it off.
5) ventilated seats fan seems weaker, airflow reduced
6) not enough storage. the small latched compartment by the driver is gone, there is a phone charging pad instead of extra storage depth (should be removable), and the glove box is limited and does not work well.
7) everything is "touch" instead of "press". i would rather have push buttons for lock/unlock or some audible lock/unlock feedback.
8) windshield washer fluid coming through the wipers, which often clog, instead of separate exterior spray points.
those are some problems with the car itself. i also have customer service and process concerns with the austin tx dealership on lakeshore rd.
my current 530 was bought from horizon automotive in san antonio. my previous 4 bmws came from trailway automotive group in austin.
i was handled badly and very unprofessionally by trailway in austin when i tried to buy there again this time. i have always lived in san antonio but had chosen to purchase in austin until that last experience.
